motion.name: menu-toggle

motion.name: menu-dropdown

motion.name: loader-orbits

motion.name: loader-pulse

motion.name: loader-to-portal
motion.value: loader exit: 250ms; portal entrance: 300ms; AnimatePresence mode: wait
motion.purpose: Sequences indeterminate loading and real content without fabricated progress.

motion.name: document-navigation
motion.purpose: Progressive @view-transition enhancement for native document navigation; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: flow-clouds
motion.purpose: Shared FlowBackdrop in every ProductPreview and sticky feature screen. Static gradient fills; Motion transforms/opacity move cloud layers only while inView, document-visible and no reduced motion.

motion.name: flow-contours
motion.purpose: Shared decorative SVG contours with opacity .15 → .5 → .15; same viewport/document/reduced-motion gate as clouds. Static contours remain when motion stops.

motion.name: loader-first-mount
motion.purpose: Do not set initial=false on the top-level loader presence boundary: it suppresses the initial repeating orbit animations.

narrative.overview: A practical fieldbook with a softer, more expressive atmosphere: graphite surfaces, lilac and blue light, large Cyrillic headlines and authentic app screens. Gradients and rounded organic backdrops bring warmth to the product presentation; installation and help keep a compact, readable rhythm.
keyCharacteristics: Soft graphite surfaces with lilac-to-blue gradients.
Large self-hosted Cyrillic typography and real platform-specific app screens.
Expressive scroll, hover, press, menu and loading motion with separate animation ownership.
Readable task pages and an immediate reduced-motion path.

rules.name: The Shared Target Rule
rules.body: Motion and GSAP must never animate the same DOM target; keep device depth on an outer wrapper and screen transitions on inner layers.

rules.name: The Accessible Motion Rule
rules.body: Animate meaningful interaction feedback while preserving native activation, visible focus and readable content; reduced motion disables decorative loops and positional effects.

dos: Do reuse the graphite surfaces and lilac-to-blue gradients for related product surfaces.
Do keep real app screens, aspect ratios, platform labels and empty states truthful.
Do retain visible focus, native buttons, pressed states and readable content when motion is reduced.
Do gate decorative loops by viewport or document visibility and loading state; keep pointer decoration local to mouse interactions.
donts: Don't return to an austere, rigid visual tone; the user requested a softer design with more library-based animation.
Don't add animation ownership conflicts, scroll hijacking or content that requires an animation to become available.
Don't present temporary iOS images as authentic Android screens.
Don't claim screenshot QA, browser QA or visual signoff from this documentation pass.
